entries.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the Ruflo MCP bridge, which was exposed on 0.0.0.0 by default. Anyone who could reach the bridge could invoke tools with no credentials.
Remote code execution in the Bifrost AI gateway. Gateways sit on the same hop as MCP tool traffic, so a gateway RCE puts tool calls and the credentials inside them in reach.

source_note: Bundled snapshot, curated by hand from public disclosures I reviewed in October 2026. It is a starting point, not a vulnerability database. The affected ranges are broad on purpose: the disclosures did not pin a clean fixed version I could verify, so the check flags the package name, cites the advisory, and leaves the version confirmation to you. Refresh it with --cve-feed and a feed file you trust.
